wrote /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/uv/add_coding_type.py: """`zlib_get_coding_type()` reports which compression the OUTPUT layer applied, and elephc applies none.

php answers `false` whenever `zlib.output_compression` is off, which is its default and what
`php -n` gives — MEASURED, `false` both outside and inside an `ob_start()`. It answers `"gzip"` or
`"deflate"` only when that ini turned output compression on.

elephc has no zlib output compression at all: the ini name appears nowhere in the tree. So `false`
is not a stub standing in for an answer — it is php's answer for every configuration elephc can be
